offering_description.value: N-able sells IT management, backup, and cybersecurity software to managed service providers and in-house IT teams. It develops cloud platforms for monitoring and securing customer systems and provides managed threat detection and response.

primary_products.value: remote monitoring and management software; backup and disaster recovery software; cybersecurity software; service desk and automation software; password and IT documentation software

customer_segment.value: B2B: Managed service providers, managed security service providers, and organizations with in-house IT teams

end_markets.value: managed IT services; managed security services; in-house IT across industries

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to IT management, backup, and security tools, typically priced by managed device, workload, or user

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Develops software that processes device and workload data for managed service providers and IT teams; service provider: Monitors security alerts and investigates threats for managed service providers and their customers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Remote IT management, data protection, cybersecurity, and service desk automation for IT providers and teams

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving managed service providers and in-house IT teams; distributors / dealers: Regional software distributors serving managed service providers; partners / resellers: Managed service providers that bundle software with IT services for their clients
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Customer data processing and security monitoring subject to privacy rules including the GDPR and U.S. state privacy laws
